pool_config.pool_brief: Build a class-based system using object-oriented programming principles. Your solution must use: a base class with a constructor and at least 2 methods, a subclass using extends and super, at least one private field (#) with a getter and setter (including validation), at least one static method or property, and demonstrate polymorphism by calling the same method on different subclass instances. All variables must use const or let.

projects.title: Interswitch Payment Processing System
projects.scenario: Build a class hierarchy for an Interswitch payment processing system. Model a base Transaction class with CardTransaction and BankTransfer subclasses, using private fields for sensitive data and static tracking.
requirements: Create a base class `Transaction` with a constructor that takes id, amount, and sender; store amount as a private field #amount with a getter and setter (setter rejects amounts <= 0)
Add a method `getSummary()` that returns 'TXN-001: ₦5000 from Amara Obi — pending'
Add a static property `count` that increments in the constructor; add a static method `getCount()` that returns the total
Create a subclass `CardTransaction` that extends Transaction, adds cardType and last4Digits, and overrides `getSummary()` to include card info
Create a subclass `BankTransfer` that extends Transaction, adds bankName and accountNumber, and overrides `getSummary()` to include bank info
Create an array of mixed Transaction instances (at least 2 CardTransaction + 2 BankTransfer) and use forEach to call getSummary() on each (polymorphism)
Log the total transaction count using the static method

files.content:

projects.title: FairMoney Loan Management System
projects.scenario: Build a class hierarchy for a FairMoney loan management system. Model a base Account class with SavingsAccount and LoanAccount subclasses, using private fields for balances and static tracking.
requirements: Create a base class `Account` with a constructor that takes id, ownerName, and balance; store balance as a private field #balance with a getter and setter (setter rejects negative values)
Add a method `getStatus()` that returns 'ACC-001: Amara Obi — ₦50,000'
Add a static property `totalAccounts` that increments in the constructor; add a static method `getTotal()` that returns the count
Create a subclass `SavingsAccount` that extends Account, adds interestRate, and overrides `getStatus()` to include 'Savings @ 8%'
Create a subclass `LoanAccount` that extends Account, adds loanTerm and monthlyPayment, and overrides `getStatus()` to include loan details
Create an array of mixed Account instances (at least 2 SavingsAccount + 2 LoanAccount) and use forEach to call getStatus() on each (polymorphism)
Log the total account count using the static method

projects.title: Carbon Credit Scoring Engine
projects.scenario: Build a class hierarchy for a Carbon credit scoring engine. Model a base User class with Borrower and Investor subclasses, using private fields for sensitive scores and static tracking.
requirements: Create a base class `User` with a constructor that takes id, name, and email; store a private field #creditScore with a getter and setter (setter clamps score between 0–850)
Add a method `getProfile()` that returns 'USR-001: Amara Obi (amara@email.com) — Score: 720'
Add a static property `userCount` that increments in the constructor; add a static method `getUserCount()`
Create a subclass `Borrower` that extends User, adds loanLimit and activeLoan, and overrides `getProfile()` to include borrower details
Create a subclass `Investor` that extends User, adds portfolioValue and riskLevel, and overrides `getProfile()` to include investor details
Create an array of mixed User instances (at least 2 Borrower + 2 Investor) and use forEach to call getProfile() on each (polymorphism)
Log the total user count using the static method

projects.title: GTBank Customer Management System
projects.scenario: Build a class hierarchy for a GTBank customer management system. Model a base Customer class with PersonalCustomer and BusinessCustomer subclasses, using private fields for account data and static tracking.
requirements: Create a base class `Customer` with a constructor that takes id, name, and tier; store a private field #accountBalance with a getter and setter (setter rejects negative values)
Add a method `getInfo()` that returns 'CUST-001: Amara Obi — Gold Tier — ₦250,000'
Add a static property `customerCount` that increments in the constructor; add a static method `getCustomerCount()`
Create a subclass `PersonalCustomer` that extends Customer, adds occupation and savingsGoal, and overrides `getInfo()` to include personal details
Create a subclass `BusinessCustomer` that extends Customer, adds businessName and annualRevenue, and overrides `getInfo()` to include business details
Create an array of mixed Customer instances (at least 2 Personal + 2 Business) and use forEach to call getInfo() on each (polymorphism)
Log the total customer count using the static method

projects.title: Konga Marketplace Product System
projects.scenario: Build a class hierarchy for a Konga marketplace product system. Model a base Product class with PhysicalProduct and DigitalProduct subclasses, using private fields for pricing and static inventory tracking.
requirements: Create a base class `Product` with a constructor that takes id, name, and category; store a private field #price with a getter and setter (setter rejects values <= 0)
Add a method `getDetails()` that returns 'PRD-001: Wireless Earbuds [Electronics] — ₦4,500'
Add a static property `inventory` that increments in the constructor; add a static method `getInventoryCount()`
Create a subclass `PhysicalProduct` that extends Product, adds weight and shippingCost, and overrides `getDetails()` to include shipping info
Create a subclass `DigitalProduct` that extends Product, adds fileSize and downloadUrl, and overrides `getDetails()` to include download info
Create an array of mixed Product instances (at least 2 Physical + 2 Digital) and use forEach to call getDetails() on each (polymorphism)
Log the total inventory count using the static method

descriptors.full: Base class has constructor with correct parameters; at least 2 methods defined; methods use `this` correctly to access instance properties
descriptors.partial: Class defined but methods don't use `this` or constructor is missing parameters
descriptors.none: No class syntax used or constructor absent

descriptors.full: extends and super used correctly; subclass overrides a method; polymorphism demonstrated by calling the same method on an array of mixed instances
descriptors.partial: extends used but super missing or incorrect; polymorphism not demonstrated
descriptors.none: No inheritance; classes are independent with no extends

descriptors.full: At least one #private field with getter and validated setter; static property increments correctly; static method accessible on the class
descriptors.partial: Private field present but setter has no validation, or static member present but not used correctly
descriptors.none: No private fields and no static members

descriptors.full: const/let used; class names are PascalCase; method names are camelCase verbs; output is clear and demonstrates each feature
descriptors.partial: Minor naming issues or incomplete demonstrations
descriptors.none: var used, poor naming, or features not demonstrated in output
